connector.name: Appdex
connector.registryDescription: iOS App Store revenue & download estimates with confidence labels
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package appdex-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.app-dex, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: APPDEX_API_KEY
env.description: Appdex API key (free tier: 5 requests/day). Optional — without a key you get 2 requests/day. Get one at https://app-dex.com/account

env.name: APPDEX_API_URL
env.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://app-dex.com — override only for staging.
